zh.title: Textron擬以12億美元出售工業部門 聚焦航太與國防
zh.summary: Textron已簽約出售旗下兩項工業事業，預計2027年上半年交割，仍須取得監管核准。
body: Textron於11月18日宣布，已簽署協議，將以12億美元把工業部門出售給Kingswood Capital Management的關係企業。交易涵蓋Kautex與Textron Specialized Vehicles，Textron預計扣除稅費和交易成本後可取得約11億美元現金。
交易預計於2027年上半年交割，仍須取得監管核准並滿足其他交割條件。Textron將保留包括塞斯納與比奇在內的Textron Aviation、貝爾直升機與Textron Systems，後續營運將聚焦航太與國防。

en.title: Textron agrees to $1.2 billion industrial sale to focus on aerospace and defense
en.summary: The sale to a Kingswood affiliate would leave Textron focused on its aviation and defense businesses. Closing is expected in the first half of 2027.
body: On November 18, Textron said it had signed a $1.2 billion agreement to sell Kautex and Textron Specialized Vehicles to a Kingswood Capital Management affiliate. It expects to receive around $1.1 billion in cash after taxes and transaction expenses.

Textron expects the deal to close in the first half of 2027 if it obtains required approvals and meets other closing conditions. The company will retain Textron Aviation, whose brands include Cessna and Beechcraft, as well as Bell and Textron Systems.

facts.claim: Textron signed a definitive agreement to sell Kautex and Textron Specialized Vehicles to a Kingswood affiliate for $1.2 billion.
Textron expects approximately $1.1 billion in net cash proceeds after taxes and transaction costs.
The company expects to close in the first half of 2027, subject to approvals and other closing conditions.
Textron Aviation, Bell and Textron Systems will remain with Textron.
